analysis.capital_judgment: 本轮资本押注的核心变量是：coprod能否把机器人硬件集成从2至3年压缩到数月，并以模块化组件加统一控制层成为基础组件的标准。已验证信号包括：组件已用于瑞士生态中的多台机器人，包括ETH Robotics Club的学生人形机器人；公司自述单次设计迭代成本为5000至25000美元。证据边界在于：这些效率与成本数字来自公司自述，商业化产品线尚未发布，首条商业组件线与洛桑原型设施仍待落地，认证与量产计划指向2027年底。

investment_rationale.quote: The biggest wins in AI will go to companies that go deep in markets where the stakes are high and generalist tools fall short. Private capital legal work is a textbook example. Shashwat and Vaneesa have spent nearly three decades between them doing this work, and it shows in the product: Perry AI doesn’t just review documents, it builds a living memory of every commitment a fund has made and acts on it.
